items.title: 68533_Sam Jones oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] You ever heard of Frank Brown? [INTERVIEWER] Hmmm. Yeah, I remember the name--Frank Brown.

ctx.x: And we stayed there. And we worked there a long time. But in, but in the night club room was a band back there named Frank Brown. You ever heard of Frank Brown?
Hmmm. Yeah, I remember the name--Frank Brown.
